latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the soil-water-management skill.

- Covers best practices for soil science, composting, and water management for food production.
- Provides clear, step-by-step guidance on soil testing (DIY and lab), interpreting NPK values, and starting composting.
- Includes practical recommendations on irrigation, rainwater harvesting, and adapting advice for different countries and measurement units.
- Offers reliable resources from Cooperative Extension programs, master gardener guides, and industry standards.
- Designed to support anyone improving garden soil, setting up irrigation, composting, or expanding food-growing capacity.
